title: Write and Record with a Nashville Songwriter
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Step by Step Guidance Perfect for beginners or seasoned music lovers the songwriter walks you through the entire process

Studio Recording Experience Go beyond writing by stepping into the studio to record your new track

Be the Artist Sing your own vocals over the song you have just created capturing the true artist in Nashville moment

Take Home a Keepsake Leave with a professional recording of your original song a souvenir no gift shop can match

Storytelling and Insider Knowledge Hear behind the scenes stories and tips about the Nashville songwriting process

All Levels Welcome No songwriting or singing experience needed just creativity and curiosity

Personalized and Private It is a one on one session so everything is tailored to the guest

Bucket List Worthy Combines the thrill of Nashvilles music culture with the rare opportunity to create something lasting
